text: Improve phase creation and deletion responsiveness; prevent duplicate phase creation on repeated Enter
description: User reports (2026-10-26): (1) After creating a phase, pressing Enter produced no visible UI response for several seconds. Pressing Enter again also appeared to do nothing; later, two phases appeared. Investigate the slow phase-creation path and provide immediate, clear pending feedback. Prevent duplicate phase creation when Enter is pressed again while the first creation is in flight (for example, guard/dedupe the submission). (2) Deleting a phase in list view is also very slow and takes several seconds. Investigate and improve phase deletion responsiveness in the list view as part of the same phase-operation performance scope.

status.comment: Validated by tests (Felix's note in next, 2026-11-02: settle review ideas through tests where possible). Cause: the dev backend restarts under tsx watch; tRPC's reconnect backoff (up to 16 s) left mutations queued and change events fell into the gap. Fix 9c478c93: reconnect at 0/250/500 ms..2 s, 'connecting' label, full resync on reconnect; covered by backend-connection.spec and MultiClient.spec. Duplicate phase on repeated Enter: PhaseCreationModal's in-flight guard now has a test (second Enter while the first create is pending is ignored; next Enter after it finishes creates again); confirmed the test fails with the guard removed. PhaseCreationModal.spec 6/6. Phase create itself costs a few ms. Reopen if a create or delete hangs again.
